**6B.7 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **strong negative evidence** that welfare-like resources were kept separate from political control. The clearest pattern is **patronage, loyalty filtering, and coercive administration**. I found only **weak counter-signals** such as technocratic cabinet staffing and occasional clemency, but nothing that shows a genuinely depoliticized welfare system.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran's presidential election dominated by Khamenei loyalists](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/irans-presidential-election-dominated-by-khamenei-loyalists-3494879 | Reuters said Khamenei ensured hardline candidates dominated the contest, the Guardian Council approved only five hardliners and one low-profile moderate from 80 applicants, and Khamenei controlled the bulk of financial resources. This is strong evidence that access to state power and resources was filtered through loyalty, not insulated from it. | 6B.7, 6B.4, 6B.6 |
| [Iran: Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/iran/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says corruption is endemic and the IRGC and bonyads are above scrutiny in practice, with broad economic power and weak accountability. That is strong evidence that public resources and benefits sat inside patronage networks rather than neutral rules. | 6B.7, 6B.4, 6B.5 |
| [IRGC extends control over Tehran's oil exports](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/irans-revolutionary-guards-extend-control-over-tehran's-oil-exports-sources-say-3778558) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-18 | https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/irans-revolutionary-guards-extend-control-over-tehrans-oil-exports-sources-say-3778558 | Reuters reported the IRGC had tightened its grip on oil exports and controlled up to half of them. Because oil revenue funds state spending, this points to capture by regime-security networks rather than clean, nonpolitical social financing. | 6B.7, 6B.4, 6B.2 |
| [Iran new compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/) | Amnesty International | 2024-12-10 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/ | Amnesty says the new law expanded enforcement powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij and imposed harsher punishments, with disproportionate effects on economically disadvantaged women and girls. This is not welfare neutrality; it is administrative coercion used to discipline a vulnerable group. | 6B.7, 6B.3, 6B.5 |
| [Pezeshkian Cabinet Profiles](https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/aug/22/pezeshkian-cabinet-profiles) | The Iran Primer / USIP | 2024-08-22 | https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/aug/22/pezeshkian-cabinet-profiles | The cabinet included reformists, hardliners, technocrats, and academics; finance minister Abdolnaser Hemmati was an economist and former Central Bank governor. This is the best weak positive signal I found, but it is indirect and does not show that welfare or jobs were broadly de-linked from patronage politics. | 6B.7, 6B.4, 6B.5 |
| [Khamenei approves pardons or commutations for 2,887 convicts](https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts) | Press TV | 2024-09-20 | https://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2024/09/20/733636/Leader-approves-pardoning-convicts | Khamenei approved pardons or commutations for 2,887 convicts, including some security-related cases and minors. This is a limited positive signal only at the margin, but it is discretionary mercy from above, not evidence that welfare or punishment were depoliticized. | 6B.7, 6B.3, 6B.6 |

**Search gap**
- I did **not** find direct 2024 reporting that Khamenei kept welfare, permits, jobs, food, housing, or benefits separate from political loyalty and punishment.
- I also did **not** find a clear 2024 case showing transparent rules that prevented patronage in social provision.
- The available evidence instead points to loyalty filtering, patronage networks, and discretionary punishment/mercy.
